LESSON: METHODS OF COOKING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Food and Nutrition
Topic 1.5: Methods of Cooking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Methods of Cooking, part of Food and Nutrition in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why is knowledge on methods of cooking important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Methods of Cooking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: the learners show concerted attention to detail as they apply the knowledge of cooking methods to prepare

food.

● Digital Literacy: the learners use digital devices to effectively accomplish their own tasks when they research on

classification of cooking methods.

● Citizenship: the learners promote social cohesion and harmony when cooking foods from different communities.

Values:
● Unity: the learners share available resources amicably during the preparation and cooking of food.

● Integrity: the learners display honesty when using resources while cooking food using different cooking methods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Health Promotion Issues: the learners are sensitised on health and nutrition issues as they discuss in groups reasons for

cooking food and present in class.

● Socio-economic and Environmental issues: learners observe safety measures as they prepare and cook food.
